narrative_summary: A smug blob taps its temple while RemoveMacAI sends Apple’s AI downloads into a dead-end port.
rationale: Candidate 5 most cleanly connects the story’s disk-space problem to RemoveMacAI’s specific closed-local-port workaround, while the Roll Safe format naturally supports the smug technical solution. It has a clearer consequence and stronger closing beat than the similarly structured Candidate 3.
